source: Intel ARK SKU pages (intel.com) that list the exact Graphics Device ID; max_threads is the largest Total Threads of any SKU listing that id
note: Platform classes come from the kernel pciids.h; caps from ARK SKU pages listing the exact Graphics Device ID. About 12 Coffee Lake SKUs stayed unidentified because ARK's listing is truncated at 32 KB (only the 0x3E91 cap could move). 11 rows were read once through a summarising fetch; the other sourced rows were read twice. 0x5921 is unsourced: no ARK page lists it, so it is never drawn. min_threads (2026-11-18): smallest Total Threads of any ARK SKU page read that lists the device id (pages read via a text proxy, about 300 SKUs of the 7th-10th gen i3/i5/i7/i9, Pentium and Celeron series); an upper bound on the true floor where the walk is incomplete (a lower unread SKU would lower it); null = no floor.
